name: Okendo
label: Okendo Merchant Enterprise REST
description: Merchant API api.okendo.io/enterprise. Basic username + api_key. extraHeaders send required okendo-api-version (default 2025-02-01). review_create is unverified on this surface. Docs: https://docs.okendo.io/merchant-rest-api
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: review_list | review_create | survey_get. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: status
schema.description: review_list filter. Review status string as documented by Okendo (e.g. approved).

schema.label: lastEvaluated
schema.description: review_list pagination cursor from a previous lastEvaluated key.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: review_list | review_create | survey_get. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type basic. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Api Version
configurationParameters.description: okendo-api-version dated header (required). Default 2025-02-01 as currently documented.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
